posts.zh:
dsh-remote-access-web#remote-access-web 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ed15e4897a481f7e0de2.html
posts.en:
dsh-remote-access-web#remote-access-web is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ed15e4897a481f7e0de2.html
